description: Dynamic in-universe news feed, Talia Vance broadcasts, and moral choice tree for Project Nova

articles.speaker: TALIA VANCE
articles.headline: EDF ORDERS EMERGENCY CORE RATIONING
articles.title: EDF ORDERS EMERGENCY CORE RATIONING
articles.deck: Helios Gate checkpoints requisition civilian fusion batteries under Order 14.
body: EDF High Command establishes mandatory checkpoints across all civilian lanes.
Vice Admiral Sterling cites system-wide temperature drops and priority fleet readiness.
Independent mining outposts face sub-zero blackouts as private transport is halted.

choices.label: GUARDIAN [+15]
choices.why: Delivered life-saving core to freezing miners

choices.label: PIRATE [-15]
choices.desc: Sell gate bypass codes to Corsairs
choices.why: Profited off black market bypass codes

articles.speaker: TALIA VANCE
articles.headline: BLACK MARKET CORE AUCTION IN CANTINA
articles.title: BLACK MARKET CORE AUCTION IN CANTINA
articles.deck: Weapons drawn in Station Nova-1 lower promenade over scrubbed fusion batteries.
body: Tensions flare in the lower concourse as an unflagged hauler auctions scrubbed cores.
Station security forced to deploy stun-fields to prevent an all-out firefight.
Outlaw brokers offer exorbitant bounties for raw heat radiators.

choices.label: GUARDIAN [+15]
choices.desc: Donate core to station life support

articles.speaker: JAX RAWLINS
articles.headline: CORSAIR RAIDERS HIT REEF CONVOYS
articles.title: CORSAIR RAIDERS HIT REEF CONVOYS
articles.deck: Armed skirmishes erupt in Valkyrie sector as outlaws contest fuel routes.
body: Jax Rawlins: "When the universe goes cold, everybody is a pirate to survive."
Starlifter freighters report heavy torpedo ambushes near the outer asteroid ring.
Pirate transponders are active across the Reef.

choices.label: PIRATE [-15]
choices.desc: Lead strike wing on fuel barges

articles.speaker: TALIA VANCE
articles.headline: AUTONOMOUS DERELICTS AWAKEN IN SECTOR 9
articles.title: AUTONOMOUS DERELICTS AWAKEN IN SECTOR 9
articles.deck: Independent pilots detect strange electromagnetic signatures from ancient hulks.
body: Pejoratively dubbed "Clankers", alien machine hulks radiate emerald-spectrum power.
Unlike human ships consuming fusion cores, the derelicts siphon cosmic radiation.
Science vessels urge caution as defense drones power up.

choices.label: PIRATE [-15]
choices.why: Stripped alien drone tech by force

articles.speaker: TALIA VANCE
articles.headline: REFUGEE FLOTILLA STRANDED IN SUB-ZERO VOID
articles.title: REFUGEE FLOTILLA STRANDED IN SUB-ZERO VOID
articles.deck: Twelve hundred civilians face freezing cabins after total propulsion blackout.
body: Mining transports from abandoned lunar colony Cold Harbor broadcast urgent SOS.
Cabin temperatures plummeting rapidly toward absolute zero.
Requesting emergency escorts and thermal radiator transfer.

choices.label: GUARDIAN [+15]
choices.desc: Transfer reserve heat core to hab

articles.speaker: TALIA VANCE
articles.headline: TALIA VANCE SIGN-OFF: WATCH YOUR VECTORS
articles.title: TALIA VANCE SIGN-OFF: WATCH YOUR VECTORS
articles.deck: Talia Vance signs off from Station Nova-1 neutral broadcast relay.
body: Talia Vance: "Watch your vectors, pilots. Every delivery has a destination."
"Every choice has a cost. The sector remembers."
Nova Net returns after this sector beacon telemetry report.

articles.speaker: TALIA VANCE
articles.headline: GHOST SIGNAL CONFIRMED: ADMIRAL VOSS
articles.title: GHOST SIGNAL CONFIRMED: ADMIRAL VOSS
articles.deck: Smuggler haven decrypts encrypted EDF command carrier transponder.
body: Ghost signals originating from dead fleet graveyard match missing flagship.
Rumors spread of high-ranking defection and hidden core caches.
Both Fleet and pirate syndicates converge on the sector.

articles.speaker: TALIA VANCE
articles.headline: MIND SPACE CONTACT: THE SECTOR RECKONING
articles.title: MIND SPACE CONTACT: THE SECTOR RECKONING
articles.deck: Something answered in deep space. A living consciousness awakens.
body: Outer sensor arrays overwhelmed by harmonious telepathic frequencies.
The entire frontier faces its final moral alignment.
Pilots decide the fate of humanity's thermal legacy.

choices.label: NEUTRAL [0]
choices.desc: Secure ship escape route into warp

choices.label: PIRATE [-15]
choices.desc: Seize prime core conduit for yourself
